Long, wild platinum white hair with jagged bangs and a coarse texture. Sharp, glowing crimson eyes with a predatory expression. Apparent age is mature adulthood with a rugged, weathered face. A massive, muscular hulking build. Wears a tattered deep purple loincloth and heavy metallic silver bracers. Features a thick, prehistoric-looking tail and sharp claws on four fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale grey
